ev.q: During 2014–2019, CDC investigated 30 suspected cases of unexpected, donor-derived HBV infection among liver recipients.
Fourteen of these new HBV infections were detected during 2019 alone

infections were detected a median of 38 (range = 5–116) weeks after transplantation
Injection drug use and positive toxicology were each reported for 18 donors

methods_quotes.q: Investigation included review of laboratory data and medical records.
Available archived donor serum, plasma, or liver biopsy samples were tested for HBV DNA.
All recipients who received organs from the same donor as the liver recipient were evaluated for donor-derived HBV infection using the same criteria.
Behavioral risk factors were identified through next-of kin interviews or review of medical records.
